column1: # Picker logo per OpenRouter model, by the vendor prefix of its id (a leading "~" is ignored).
# TAB-separated. prefix = the start of the id; the longest matching prefix wins, so "google/gemma" beats
# "google/". icon = catalog/icons/or/<icon>.png (64x64, from lobe-icons; see catalog/icons/build.sh).
# A vendor not listed here gets the OpenRouter logo (catalog/icons/or/openrouter.png).
